adapters.doc: AMQP 0-9-1 brokers (RabbitMQ 4.x is the one its kit runs against), through the zero-dependency client in amqp/: confirmed publication, an observer on a queue of its own bound beside the application's, and the fixture's own queues

publish.doc: publish one message with its logical id on a confirm channel, mandatory: confirmed, rejected or returned; a confirm that never came is ambiguous

observe.doc: arm an observer: declare its own expiring queue and bind it to the channel's exchange, refusing one somebody else consumes

observe.await.doc: read the observer's own queue for a bounded window, acknowledging what it takes; complete only when the queue was read empty

fixture.prepare.doc: declare the fixture's own exchanges, queues and bindings, every name inside its namespace

fixture.cleanup.doc: delete the fixture's own queues while unused, and say what it left and why; it never deletes an exchange
